ITEM 1 | Square white plate about 26 cm across used as scale; dark leafy greens, mostly bright green arugula-like leaves with thin pale stems, loosely piled in the upper left, with a small orange-red tomato piece tucked in the center, leaves glossy and slightly wet | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale off-white fish fillet, flaky and moist-looking, with light golden-brown seared edges on the top-left corner, cut into a rough triangular slab about 7 cm by 5 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the left edge of the plate beside the greens | 110
ITEM 3 | Cubes of grilled eggplant, about 2 cm pieces, deep purple skin with dark char marks and browned caramelized spots, softer translucent-looking flesh inside, clustered in the lower center next to the fish | 70
ITEM 4 | Thin green asparagus spears, about 0.8 cm thick and 10 to 12 cm long, bright green with slightly darker tips, lightly cooked and firm, arranged in a loose bundle on the right side of the plate, about 10 spears | 90
ITEM 5 | Small scattered green herb leaves, flat-leaf parsley-like, a few pieces about 1 to 2 cm, dark green and slightly wilted, lying around the base of the fish slab | 3
